selection.ranking: Minimum absolute deviation from 0.30m baseline, then minimum frame gap, then maximum depth-visible ratio, visible vertices and projected area, then earliest frame.

forbidden_after_freeze: open candidate RGB or call a model before all three active frames are fixed
change baseline, eligibility or ranking after viewing a selected image
replace an active frame after downstream failure
claim provider-selected reference views establish raw-camera binding or navigation authority
claim_boundary: This freeze uses provider geometry and depth to select one active second reference view per already privileged target before RGB/model access. It is Development input selection, not raw-camera target binding, user-action feasibility, provider-independent generalization, navigation, arrival, handoff, benefit, reliability or safety evidence.
